steps.name: Click on In Store Digital Tab
Clicking on PlayList Templates Tab
Clicking on Create New Playlist Template Button
Click on Template Creation Submit Button
Verify playlist name Error Message is Displayed
Entering data in playlist Name Field
Click on Template Creation Submit Button
Verify playlist name Error Message is Displayed
Entering data in playlist Name Field
Click on Template Creation Submit Button
Validate Playlist Template Name field is Accepting More Than 60 Characters
Entering data in playlist Name Field
Entering data in Ad Format Description Field
Selecting desired screen Type
Entering data in No Of Slots Field
Selecting Desired Per Slot Duration
Entering data in Price Per Slot Field
Selecting Desired Max Slots Per Advertiser Radio Button
Selecting Desired Maximum Slot Selection
Selecting Desired Ad Format Selection
Click on Add New Ad Format Button
Enter the ad Name
Click on Choose From Creative Library Button
Searching tag name search field for creative library
Selecting first image from creative library
Clicking On Choose Button creative library
Click on Save Playlist Template Button
Selecting Desired Ad Format Selection
Clicking on Video Ad Format Type
Click on Add New Ad Format Button
Enter the ad Name
Click on Choose From Creative Library Button
Searching tag name search field for creative library
Selecting first video from creative library
